build_image_encoder: build an image encoder from a config dict with type CLIPImageEncoder, DinoImageEncoder, or DinoImageEncoderMV
create_dual_image_encoder: create a dual image encoder with a main and additional encoder that returns outputs under main and additional keys
create_single_image_encoder: create a single image encoder wrapping one encoder config and returning outputs under the main key
create_clip_image_encoder: create a CLIP-based image encoder using CLIPVisionModelWithProjection for single-image feature extraction
create_dino_image_encoder_mv: create a multi-view Dino image encoder that adds view embeddings and handles batched multi-view input tensors
